"""Fresh AS two-level issuance after exactly one real root second boundary."""
import json
import time
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import psycopg
import pytest
from agent_guard.crypto.sm import verify_compact_jws
from agent_guard.execution.query import AuthorizedQuery
from agent_guard.contracts.ledger import ErrorCode,LedgerError
from tests.integration import test_verified_execution as setup
from tests.fixtures.gateway import query_bundle
from tests.integration.test_consent_final_decision import _wait_blocked,_wait_expired
from tests.integration.test_a31_inherited_trusted_material import full
from tests.fixtures.receipts import _journal_delta

@pytest.mark.parametrize('round_id',range(10))
@pytest.mark.parametrize('window',['root','mid','leaf','token'])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('positive',[False,True])
def test_real_root_cross_second_two_children_and_persisted_deadline(ledger,dsn,downstream_dsn,monkeypatch,round_id,window,positive):
    root_fn,form_fn=setup._root,setup._form
    issuance=[]
    def root(*args,approved_overrides=None):
        values=dict(approved_overrides or {})
        if window=='root':values['task_expires_at']=int(time.time())+8
        return root_fn(*args,approved_overrides=values)
    def form(key,parent_token,**kwargs):
        parent=verify_compact_jws(parent_token,expected_type='ag-at+jwt',trusted_keys={'as-sign-1':key.public_key()})
        if parent['ag_delegation_remaining']==2:
            start=time.monotonic()
            while int(time.time())<=parent['iat']:
                assert time.monotonic()-start<2
                time.sleep(.005)
            assert int(time.time())==parent['iat']+1,'one actual second boundary, no intentional window exhaustion'
        now=int(time.time())
        requested=kwargs.get('ttl',180)
        if window=='root':requested=min(requested,8)
        if window=='mid':requested=min(requested,6)
        remaining=parent['exp']-now-2
        assert remaining>0 and now<parent['exp']
        ttl=min(requested,remaining)
        assert 0<ttl and now+ttl<=parent['exp']-2
        kwargs['ttl']=ttl
        issuance.append({'parent_iat':parent['iat'],'parent_exp':parent['exp'],'depth':parent['ag_delegation_remaining'],'now':now,'ttl':ttl})
        return form_fn(key,parent_token,**kwargs)
    monkeypatch.setattr(setup,'_root',root);monkeypatch.setattr(setup,'_form',form)
    env=setup.signed_env(dsn,downstream_dsn,leaf_ttl=3)
    assert len(issuance)==2 and issuance[0]['now']==issuance[0]['parent_iat']+1
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as c:
        signed=c.execute('SELECT t.token_jws,g.expires_at FROM ag_grants g JOIN ag_grant_tokens t USING(grant_id) ORDER BY g.depth').fetchall()
    claims=[verify_compact_jws(t,expected_type='ag-at+jwt',trusted_keys={'as-sign-1':env.as_key.public_key()}) for t,_ in signed]
    assert len(claims)==3 and all(c['exp']==int(exp.timestamp()) for c,(_,exp) in zip(claims,signed))
    assert all(p['iat']<=c['iat']<c['exp']<=p['exp'] for p,c in zip(claims,claims[1:]))
    op=env.adapter.accept(env.bundle()).operation_id;bundle=query_bundle(env,op)
    index={'root':0,'mid':1,'leaf':2,'token':2}[window]
    deadline=signed[index][1]
    if window=='token':assert int(deadline.timestamp())==bundle.query.token_exp
    before,downstream=full(dsn),full(downstream_dsn,'ds_')
    with psycopg.connect(dsn,autocommit=True) as observer,psycopg.connect(dsn) as blocker,ThreadPoolExecutor(1) as pool:
        blocker.execute('SELECT operation_id FROM ag_operations WHERE operation_id=%s FOR UPDATE',(op,))
        future=pool.submit(AuthorizedQuery(dsn,evidence_store=env.evidence).query,bundle)
        _wait_blocked(observer,blocker.info.backend_pid,'FROM ag_operations')
        lock_rows=observer.execute("SELECT pid,wait_event_type,pg_blocking_pids(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE %s=ANY(pg_blocking_pids(pid))",(blocker.info.backend_pid,)).fetchall()
        assert len(lock_rows)>=1 and all(r[1]=='Lock' for r in lock_rows)
        if not positive:_wait_expired(observer,deadline)
        observed_now=observer.execute('SELECT clock_timestamp()').fetchone()[0]
        if positive:assert observed_now<deadline
        else:assert observed_now>=deadline
        blocker.commit()
        if positive:
            assert future.result(timeout=5)['status']=='RESERVED'
            after=full(dsn)
            _journal_delta({'gateway':before},{'gateway':after},interactions=(('QUERY',op,bundle.evidence_ref),))
            assert len(after['ag_proofs'])==len(before['ag_proofs'])+1
            assert {k:v for k,v in after.items() if k!='ag_proofs'}=={k:v for k,v in before.items() if k!='ag_proofs'}
        else:
            with pytest.raises(LedgerError) as failure:future.result(timeout=5)
            assert failure.value.code is ErrorCode.EXPIRED
            assert full(dsn)==before
        assert full(downstream_dsn,'ds_')==downstream
        print('R2_REAL_SECOND_WITNESS',json.dumps({'round':round_id,'window':window,'positive':positive,'issuance':issuance,'selected_exp':int(deadline.timestamp()),'db_clock':observed_now.isoformat(),'blocked_backend_ids':[r[0] for r in lock_rows],'blocker_pid':blocker.info.backend_pid,'ancestor_expiry_bounds_leaf':True},sort_keys=True))
